static_proxy.scope: Canonical trailing metadata only, full file hash/size custody; no full static graph or runtime invocation verification claimed.

code_acceptance_and_original_criterion_d: Separate; ledger statuses not reclassified by check counts.
cleanup_policy: Only candidate list; no deletion or Trash action. Preserve unique deciding bytes/code/docs. Check no active users before repeatables move to native Trash; without Trash keep exact candidates.
raw_local_input_limitation: Raw graph/private config remain outside Git; exact command/source/hash/size and complete moderate stdout are published. Do not promote the bounded static proxy to runtime proof.
